scripts.css:build: cd src && pnpm exec rsbuild build --environment css --env-mode full
scripts.css:build:lite: cd src && pnpm exec rsbuild build --environment css --env-mode lite
scripts.build:js: cd src && pnpm exec rsbuild build --environment js --env-mode full
scripts.build:js:lite: cd src && pnpm exec rsbuild build --environment js --env-mode lite
scripts.build:dashboard: cd src && pnpm exec rsbuild build -c rsbuild.dashboard.config.ts
scripts.watch:css: cd src && pnpm exec rsbuild build --environment css --env-mode full --watch
scripts.watch:js: cd src && pnpm exec rsbuild build --environment js --env-mode full --watch
scripts.lint: biome lint --no-errors-on-unmatched package/luci-theme-fluent/htdocs package/luci-mod-fluentdashboard/htdocs src/web/resources src/web/fluentdashboard src/rsbuild.dashboard.config.ts luci-dashboard-i18n.config.ts
scripts.format: biome format --write --no-errors-on-unmatched package/luci-theme-fluent/htdocs package/luci-mod-fluentdashboard/htdocs src/web/resources src/web/fluentdashboard src/rsbuild.dashboard.config.ts luci-dashboard-i18n.config.ts
scripts.i18n:build: pnpm run i18n:extract-ucode -- --generate && dotenvx run -- luci-types i18n
scripts.test: pnpm run test:menu-layout && pnpm run test:apply-change-preview && pnpm run test:dashboard
scripts.screenshot: pnpm run screenshot:run && pnpm run screenshot:showcase && pnpm run screenshot:run:zh-Hans && pnpm run screenshot:showcase:zh-Hans
scripts.typecheck: cd src && pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
